name: Spring-charge timeout alarm
summary: Detects failure to obtain the charged indication within the defined supervision interval.
description: Detects failure to obtain the charged indication within the defined supervision interval. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charging demand and status” at the input and “Charge-timeout alarm” at the output. The alarm interval is not a universal charging limit.
